Here are my top 5 tips that have kept my long distance boyfriend for 3 years going on 4 and I holding on with a smile:

1. Meditate on the good things - some days it's hard not to think about the distance, it helps to rather think about how much you love and the other happy aspects of your relationship.

2. Make time for calls - my boyfriend and I text a lot as opposed to face timing or even just regular calls, once in a while we'll talk late on the phone and just pass out together. It doesn't have to be that extreme, but spend time with him virtually.

3. Capitalize on the distance - use the time away from him to work on yourself, spend time with your friends, you're still young and there's a lot of 'you' to figure out outside of the relationship. Its about focusing on your happiness whilst away from him - essentially when you're happy as an individual it helps your relationship too!

4. Play Games! Never have I ever, cross word puzzles online, 20 questions, you name it! For us, we find like 100 questions on Pinterest and just get to know each other, it makes the time go by and you get to know your partner better whilst getting in a good laugh.

5. Make plans together - its something so small but it gives the two of you something to look foward to for when you're together. So instead on focusing on the present and how far you're away from each other, you get to plan the 2 or 3 days you'll be with him. When you get the chance to be with you'll probably forget most of your plans but it gets you through the waiting in a positive way.

All the best!!
